Welcome to the pages for Wageningen University & Research PhD candidates. Your starting point to find the information you need.
Why a PhD at WUR?
Why at WUR?
Wageningen University & Research (WUR) has a name for innovative and ground-breaking research. When it comes to research and providing education, Wageningen University & Research enjoys an outstanding international reputation. As a PhD candidate at WUR, you will develop knowledge that serves mankind and society at large.

Open PhD positions (15)
Open positions
See all positions
Vacancy
PhD position on radar detection of logging in tropical forests
Are you passionate about the reducing illegal timber trade from tropical forests? Do you aspire developing scientific tools to curb illegal trade? Then this PhD position could be a good fit for you! We are looking for a bright and highly qualified team player in this applied research project.
Vacancy
PhD position on forensic tracing of tropical timber
Are you passionate about the reducing illegal timber trade from tropical forests? Do you aspire developing scientific tools to curb illegal trade? Then this PhD position could be a good fit for you! We are looking for a bright and highly qualified team player in this applied research project.
Vacancy
PhD Candidate in Child Eating Behaviour
Do you want to uncover how food properties shape children's eating behaviour and energy intake, combining nutrition, sensory science and innovative digital tools to help promote healthier eating? Join our Child Eating Behaviour team as PhD candidate at Wageningen University & Research.
Vacancy
PhD: Impact evaluation of climate policies in agricultural and forest landscapes
Have you ever wondered how we can ensure that climate mitigation and adaptation policies are fair, coherent, and effective? Are you interested in applying state-of-the-art impact evaluation techniques to analyze how climate policies affect land use, GHG emissions, and biodiversity?
Vacancy
PhD: The link between mountains, downstream agriculture and ecosystems globally
Are you interested in the role of mountains in the global hydrological cycle? And in what happens to downstream water supply when mountains change? Do you like working with numerical models? Then this PhD might be your next step!
Vacancy
PhD Developing green façades for building insolation & enhancing urban diversity
The project goal is to help bio-based facade panels that keep buildings cool, insulate, support biodiversity, and contribute to more sustainable urban environments.
Vacancy
PhD: Economics of native species production and rural development in the Cerrado
Have you ever asked yourself if it is possible to harness the economic potential of biodiversity without degrading the environment? Would you like to understand how we can develop markets for native plant species that benefit rural communities while conserving biodiversity? Do you speak Portuguese?
Vacancy
PhD Researcher in Atmospheric Sciences - Emerging extreme fire weather risks
Are you a meteorologist or climate scientist with a passion to investigate the interactions between climate extremes and wildfire risks? Do you want to work on a research project that aims to understand the most extreme fire weather events possible, and how they will evolve in a warming world?
Vacancy
PhD – Militarization of Societal Resilience
In this PhD, you study how militarization in the Netherlands unfolds and examine its effects.
Vacancy
PhD – Resilience against disaster and war in the Netherlands
In this PhD research, you look at the implementation and impact of such resilience initiatives to discover how well they prepare residents for crises.
Vacancy
PhD: 3D radiation in clouds and wildfire plumes using GPUs and machine learning
Sunlight and heat radiation move through the atmosphere in three dimensions, yet almost every weather and climate model still treats radiation as a purely vertical process. We want to change that.
Vacancy
PhD: Moss traits and fire ignition in high-latitude peatland & tundra ecosystems
Are you intrigued by interactions between vegetation and fire? Are you passionate about lab-, field-, and remote sensing-based research? Do you like solving scientific puzzles?
Vacancy
PhD position in genome evolution and architecture in unicellular eukaryotes
Are you fascinated by how eukaryotic genomes evolve? Do you want to look beyond model organisms and point mutations to uncover the complexity of genome evolution?
Vacancy
PhD PFAS removal with activated carbon in drinking water treatment
PFAS are among the most challenging contaminants facing drinking water utilities worldwide.
Vacancy
PhD Replacing Chemicals with Electricity: Engineering Local pH Environments
Can electricity replace acids, bases, and cleaning chemicals used throughout industry today? How do local pH conditions develop near electrodes and membranes in electrochemical systems, and how can they be controlled?

EPS
The national Graduate School Experimental Plant Sciences (EPS) organises and coordinates fundamental and strategic plant research of the collaborating universities and institutes, aiming at the development of new principles in plant molecular biology, plant physiology, plant growth for sustainable agriculture and horticulture, plant breeding and plant protection.
Go to the EPS website
PE&RC
The mission of Production Ecology and Resource Conservation (PE&RC) is “Understanding the functioning of natural and managed ecosystems to improve the quality of life”. This mission can be viewed from a local, regional and global perspective, considering bio-/geo-physical and socio-economic objectives and constraints.
Go to the PE&RC website
VLAG
The mission of VLAG Graduate School (VLAG) is to develop the careers of young researchers and to promote research collaboration in Biobased, Biomolecular, Chemical, Food and Nutrition Sciences.
More about Vlag
WASS
The mission of Wageningen School of Social Sciences (WASS) is to understand social processes with regard to today’s global challenges of disparities and poverty, of responsible production and consumption, of natural resource use and the environment, as well as of knowledge in society.
More about WASS
WIAS
The mission of Wageningen Institute of Animal Sciences (WIAS) is to improve our understanding of animals and their various roles for mankind through fundamental and strategic research and training of early stage researchers (PhD and post-doc).
More about WIAS
WIMEK
Wageningen Institute for Environment and Climate Research (WIMEK) aims to develop an integrated understanding of environmental change, its impact on the quality of life and sustainability and offers solutions for environmental improvement by:
conducting innovative scientific and technological research.
offering PhD training and education.
dissemination emerging insights, recent research results and novel technological & policy approaches to companies, regulating authorities and society.
More about WIMEK
